candidates.selection_reason: Independent mouse injury cohort with author-defined primed AT2 and DATP states, day 14 in the original window
candidates.source_reuse: Previously studied elsewhere in this repository; independent of Strunz but not an untouched research source
candidates.unit_evidence: Methods state two mice pooled per experiment; one deposited day14 Tomato-positive sample. Negative-lineage sort is not an independent animal replicate; day28 is outside the frozen window.

candidates.selection_reason: Independent adult LPS-injury epithelial study with a differentiating alveolar population and animal-labelled samples
candidates.unit_evidence: Two experimental injured-mouse labels; each is represented by two explicitly technical libraries. Four libraries are not four mice.

precision_scope: Analytic 95% t-interval half-width in multiples of a planning between-mouse SD. Not power, a chosen sample size, or an equivalence margin.
decision: No eligible cohort among the primary and one fallback; T3 scoring not launched. Broader availability remains unsearched.
